title: Add "Add to Cart" Button on Product Listing Page
acceptance_criteria: Button Visibility: Given the product listing/catalog view, When it is displayed, Then an "Add to Cart" button is displayed on every product card.
Action: Given a product with an "Add to Cart" button, When the customer clicks it, Then the item is successfully added to the user's shopping cart.

Feedback: Given the customer has clicked "Add to Cart", When the item is added, Then a visual indicator is shown to the user (e.g., a toast notification like "Item added to cart!" or a quick button state change to "Added ✓").

Cart Counter: Given the customer has added an item to the cart, When the add completes, Then the cart icon counter in the website header updates dynamically in real-time to reflect the new item count.
Inventory Handling: Given a product is out of stock, When it is displayed on the product listing, Then the button is disabled and labeled "Out of Stock".
Guest Users: Given a guest user adds an item to the cart, When the item is added, Then the cart items are stored in local storage/session.
Logged-in Users: Given a logged-in user adds an item to the cart, When the item is added, Then the cart items sync with the backend database.
Technical Note / DoD: API endpoint /api/cart/add must be integrated.
Technical Note / DoD: Unit tests are written and passed for UI component states (In stock, Out of stock, Success state).
Technical Note / DoD: Tested on desktop and mobile responsive views.
